chapter: Excelsior Brass Band and Red Allen's band
title: The Matthews brothers on snare and traps; Remus in church
summary: Remus Matthews played snare drum, Turk and Bill also played; talk of Remus playing in a sanctified church and the old timers dying out.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Who was the snare drummer then?
Uh?
Who was the snare drummer?
Uh, Remus Matthews.
Oh, yeah. Happy.

Yeah. Well, they had three Matthews boys at that time. Used to be Bill played, Trumbo. Remus played snare drum. And his brothers, one called Turk, he used to play. Traps and snare drum, too, in the band.
Well, who was Bebe Matthews? Which one was Bebe?
Bebe, that's the one that played, uh, played trap drums.
Oh, that's, that's the same as Turk.
Yeah. That's it. Right around the corner.
Yeah. On, uh, Opelousas or?
On Newton's street, yeah.
On Newton.
Yeah, right in the back of me over there. Oh, yeah. Yeah.
Yeah, I used to hear Bebe, uh, I mean, I used to hear Remus in church. Huh? I used to hear Remus in church, in that sanctified church.

Well, Remus, Remus never, Remus always played. Yeah. The snare drum in the brass band. Yeah. He never played in the orchestra or nothing. Mm-hmm. But he was a good snare drum player in the brass band. Yeah.
Well, he was good in church. Yeah. He was playing bass drum in church.

Well, yeah, we played, he played in church. He, Remus, after that, Remus got out of the, they all retired out of the band, Remus did, and, Remus, he came after going back to church. And, um, well, he'd take my heart attack too, and he died out. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.
Mm-hmm.
Bebe died. Bill died. Yeah. All them fellas practically died out, all them old timers. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.
